run_gpt2_sample_generation: run the GPT2 model to generate text samples from an input file or interactively via command line
build_gpt2_model: build a GPT2 model with configurable layers, hidden size, attention heads, and FP16 support for distributed inference
generate_unconditional_samples: generate unconditional text samples from the GPT2 model and write them to a JSON output file
apply_top_k_top_p_filtering: apply top-k and top-p nucleus filtering to model logits to control token sampling diversity
setup_model_with_checkpoint: setup a GPT2 model and optionally load pretrained weights from a checkpoint directory
